_comment: Copy this file to tools/diagrams-auth.json (gitignored) and fill in real values captured from a live Designer/Copilot 'Create' image-generation session in your browser's DevTools Network tab. All values expire (~1 hour) — capture them fresh right before running the script.
_howTo: 1. Open https://copilot.cloud.microsoft/create (or wherever the Designer image-creation tool lives) and open DevTools > Network.
2. Generate one image manually with any prompt, so a 'generate.ashx?intent=image' POST appears in the Network tab.

3. Click that request, open the Headers tab, and copy these exact header VALUES (not names) into the fields below: sessionid, deviceid, userid, containerid, filetoken, authorization, x-dc-hint, x-modelvariant, origin, referer.
4. apiBase / audienceGroup / caller / clientName / operationType can usually be left at their defaults below.
5. Run: node tools/generate-diagrams.js --dry-run   (prints prompts + targets without calling the API)
6. Run: node tools/generate-diagrams.js             (generates for real, once you're happy with the dry-run)
